subject: Re: BrightBridge overnight POC - QPS stabilizer credit request
messages:
From: Devon Park <devon@brightbridge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra credits for overnight POC surge

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the team and I are aligned to run a 72-hour overnight load validation starting next Tuesday (7/31) to verify p95 latency and throughput for our embeddings+rerank pipeline. We expect a sustained window at peak QPS between 600-800 requests/sec and several long-tail bursts.

Quick ask: can Redwood provision a supplemental credit allowance for this run (ballpark 120k token-equivalent) or extend our trial window so we can complete the soak? Without the top-up we’ll have to split the test and rebaseline, which would push our pilot by two weeks.

Attached is our test plan (load-plan-72h.csv) and a short checklist of what we’ll validate. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you need more context.

Thanks,
Devon Park
Sr. Engineering Manager — BrightBridge
devon@brightbridge.com

--
Attachment: load-plan-72h.csv (CSV)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra credits for overnight POC surge

Devon — appreciate the detail and the plan. This is the right kind of run to validate throughput and p95 behavior; we’d like to support it.

Two quick clarifying questions for our ops/finance side:
- Can you confirm the start/end window (UTC) and whether the entire 72h needs uninterrupted credits?
- Will you require burst concurrency beyond the 800 QPS peak mentioned (any scripted spikes >2s latencies)?

Ben / Karthik — can we provision a preliminary promo allowance for BrightBridge to cover the run while procurement completes paperwork? Vivek — can you confirm any kernel/instance recommendations (quantization / batch size) for a late-night soak like this?

If procurement can sign a PO after the run we can do a provisional credit grant today and then reconcile. Devon — I’ll propose a 48h immediate supplement to unblock the first half of the run and escalate for the additional 24h contingent on the PO.

I’ll follow up with an approval thread once I hear back from Ben.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0142

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra credits for overnight POC surge

Team — approved to grant a discretionary promo top-up to BrightBridge to unblock the soak. Details:
- Immediate provisional grant: 80k token-equivalent credit (48h coverage)
- Contingent uplift: additional 40k tokens (to reach 120k total) once PO is received and HubSpot deal updated

Finance note: anything over 100k requires procurement confirmation; Ben to liaise with PMM for promotional exceptions if needed.

Tessa — I’ve attached the internal authorization stub (promo-authorization.pdf) for audit. Karthik / Vivek, please confirm whether we should pin them to a dedicated sandbox pool or use burst routing from the shared pool for lower latency.

Ben
